translations.text: God be with me against every trouble: the noble Trinity that is one, Father and Son and Holy Spirit.
The pure holy King of the sun, fairer than every [?], is a wonderful refuge for me against the host of black demons.
The Father, the Son, the glorious Holy Spirit: may the three of them protect me against the clouds of plagues,
against sudden death, against a fall, against the plundering of brigands. May high Jesus save me from the red disease.
Against demons of every [?] it is the Son of God who protects me, against disease, against wounding, against thunder, against fire.
Against heavy slaughter, against every other harshness, may the Son of Mary carefully bless my body.
Against judgements at Doom, Christ be with me against every trouble, against pangs, against terror, against the poisons of the winds,
against danger, against betrayal, against charms in secret, against pestilence of every form that it brings upon the world.
Every blessing without blemish, every pure prayer, every ladder that reaches heaven: may they be a help to me.
Every good saint who suffered on the surface of the earth below, every holy disciple who believed in Christ,
every meek one, every gentle one, every simple one, every shining one, every confessor, every soldier who has fought under the sun,
every venerable holy patron who would help me [?] as is fitting, every simple one, every noble one, every saint who suffered the cross,
every glorious pilgrim, every [?] (renowned in power), every naked one, every saint who left his land,
every unfailing tongue on which grace was bestowed, every heart in the world that brings about no betrayal,
every generous righteous one under the plain of bright heaven, from the setting of the sun in the west to Mount Zion in the east:
may they protect me from here on against the demons of the mist, the companions of the King's Son from the lands of the living.
May God protect me, the Lord of glorious angels; a command came from him that [?] might arrive safe.
May my King protect me; may he save me at every time; may I be safe from every danger under the shelter of God's palm.
